label: proprietary trading system
context: A backtest is evidence, not proof. State the baseline, the sample, and the out-of-sample check before claiming an edge.
Lookahead bias, survivorship bias, and overfitting to a single regime are the default failure modes. Actively test for them.
Execution assumptions (fills, slippage, fees, borrow) change results more than signal tweaks. Make them explicit.
Risk limits and position sizing are part of the strategy, not a wrapper added later.
